description: Task 19 capacity qualification of the large XLSX/ODS interchange path. 'runs' holds the unmodified output of tests/qualify_large_interchange.py for the standard content mix (all sizes and formats) and for a supplementary 1,000,000-cell run with --long-text-share 0; 'decision' applies the qualification rule across both.

limitations: Host-specific: one machine, its disk and an uncontrolled (warm) OS file cache; not OS-cold.
Peak RSS is the service child's resident memory sampled every 50 ms plus its ru_maxrss at exit; the driver is excluded.
Phase seconds for jobs include the SDK's polling interval (at most 0.5 s).
One generated content mix; other workbook shapes (more long text, more formulas, more styles) can cost more.

ods_1000000_standard_mix.reason: Not measurable: DataHorizon's ODS export of the imported 1,000,000-cell standard-mix workbook was rejected with LIMIT ('Expanded ODS export exceeds 256 MiB') while writing the ODS source, so no 1,000,000-cell ODS package of this mix exists within the expanded-byte limit. The ODS writer stores each text twice (office:string-value and text:p) and every space as <text:s/>; at 500,000 cells the standard-mix ODS export is 203,074,577 bytes expanded, about 406 bytes per cell, so 1,000,000 cells would need about 406 MB, over the 268,435,456-byte LARGE_EXPANDED. This is the expanded-byte limit doing its job, not a time or memory failure.

cells.basis: XLSX qualifies at 100,000, 500,000 and 1,000,000 cells with the standard mix (slowest phase 30.907 s prepare, peak service RSS 93,044,736 B). ODS qualifies at 100,000 and 500,000 with the standard mix and at 1,000,000 with the same mix minus long text (slowest 35.33 s, peak 100,335,616 B). Every qualifying 1,000,000-cell case reopened in at most 0.792 s including its first viewport. ODS workbooks of 1,000,000 cells are therefore qualified only within LARGE_EXPANDED; text-heavier ones are rejected by that byte limit with LIMIT.

bytes.headroom_rule: limit = min(provisional, ceil(1.5 x largest measured qualifying size / 16 MiB) x 16 MiB)

not_qualified_or_not_run: ODS at 1,000,000 cells with the standard mix (rejected by LARGE_EXPANDED while producing its source; see ods_1000000_standard_mix)
ODS at 500,000 cells without long text was not run
Inline-string XLSX was not measured (generator default: shared strings)
OS-cold opening was not measured (warm, uncontrolled cache)
Other hosts (Windows, Linux, Intel Mac) were not measured
